faq_hr_8_q: Will a seat cushion cure hemorrhoids?
faq_hr_8_a: No. A seat cushion can only help with comfort by spreading sitting pressure. Hemorrhoid care usually centres on fiber, fluids, avoiding straining and, where needed, treatment from a doctor.
faq_hr_9_q: Is a donut cushion or a U-shaped cushion better?
faq_hr_9_a: For long sits, many people find a U-shaped or keyhole relief vent more comfortable because there is no closed rim pressing around the opening. Melara Sitora uses a hollow relief vent under the tailbone.
faq_hr_10_q: Can I use it after childbirth or surgery?
faq_hr_10_a: Many people find a contoured cushion more comfortable. Always follow your doctor's, midwife's or surgeon's after-care instructions first.
ws_heading: Why sitting on a hard seat
ws_intro: Hemorrhoids are very common: one colonoscopy-based study found them in nearly 4 in 10 adults.<sup>1</sup> They are swollen vascular cushions in the anal canal that can become tender or irritated.<sup>2</sup> When you are sensitive, how you sit matters.
ws_0_d: On a flat, hard seat your weight is carried by a small contact area. Contoured, cushioned seats spread the load and lower peak pressure.<sup>3</sup>
ws_1_d: Hours in one position load the same tissue the whole time. A long meeting or drive often feels worse than a short sit.
ws_2_d: Straining and lingering on the toilet are recognised contributors to symptomatic hemorrhoids,<sup>2,4</sup> and phone use on the toilet has been linked to a higher likelihood of them.<sup>5</sup>
ws_3_d: A tender area that is pressed on all day has little chance to calm down between flare-ups, so everyday sitting feels like a chore.
ws_note: No clinical trial has shown that a seat cushion treats or shrinks hemorrhoids. A cushion is about pressure distribution and comfort. Fiber, fluids and not straining remain the first-line advice.<sup>6,7</sup>
who_0_d: Sit 8+ hours a day on firm chairs, with little chance to shift. Pressure builds as the day goes on.
who_1_d: Hours behind the wheel in a fixed posture. A supportive, non-slip seat helps you sit comfortably for longer.
who_2_d: Hemorrhoids are common in late pregnancy and after birth.<sup>8</sup> A contoured seat can make sitting and feeding more comfortable. Follow your midwife's or doctor's advice.
who_3_d: Comfort while you follow your doctor's or surgeon's after-care instructions, with less pressure on tender areas.

ch_intro: Keep these five factors in mind when you shop.
ch_ring: Ring (donut) cushions relieve the centre but can create a rim of higher pressure around it, and pressure-injury guidelines advise against ring-type devices.<sup>9</sup> A U-shaped or keyhole relief vent leaves the rear open without a closed rim, which is the design Melara Sitora uses.
ch_0_d: Choose a U-shaped or keyhole vent for long sits. Contoured foam spreads weight over a wider area.
ch_1_d: High-density memory foam stays supportive. Foam that is too soft bottoms out and stops relieving pressure.
ch_2_d: A removable breathable cover keeps you cooler and cleaner, which matters when skin is sensitive.
ch_3_d: Check the size against your chair or car seat, and look for a base that stays put when you shift.
ch_4_d: Quality foam keeps its shape for months, not weeks. Check the return policy.

faq_hr_1_q: Is this a good cushion for hemorrhoids?
faq_hr_1_a: Melara Sitora is designed for exactly this problem: a hollow relief vent keeps direct seat pressure off your tailbone and the tender area around it, while the contoured seat spreads your weight over a wider area. It is a comfort and support accessory, not a replacement for professional medical diagnosis or treatment, and it does not treat, cure or shrink hemorrhoids. If you have rectal bleeding, or discomfort that is persistent, worsening or severe, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.
faq_hr_2_q: What makes it different from a regular cushion?
faq_hr_2_a: A regular cushion is usually flat. Melara Sitora is a one-piece seat and backrest with five support zones: a lumbar curve, upright posture wings, a hollow relief vent under the tailbone, a contoured seat for your sit bones, and thigh grooves that keep your legs level.
faq_hr_4_q: Is it suitable for everyday sitting?
faq_hr_4_a: Yes. It is designed for everyday sitting at your desk, dining table, sofa or in the car. As with any seat, it helps to stand up and move around regularly.
faq_hr_0_a: It measures 44 × 42 × 32 cm (17.3 × 16.5 × 12.6 in, W × D × H) and fits most sofas, dining chairs, car seats and office chairs with a seat at least 44 cm (17.3 in) wide. Just set it on the seat and sit back.
faq_hr_7_a: We offer refunds within 30 days of purchase. Just contact our support team and we'll guide you through the return.
faq_hr_3_a: Both, in the right places. The slow-rebound memory foam is soft enough to sink into and supportive enough to hold its shape. It springs back in about 5 seconds and doesn't flatten.
faq_hr_5_q: Will it slide around on my chair?
faq_hr_5_a: No. The base is covered in silicone anti-slip dots, so the cushion stays in place even when you shift or lean back.
faq_hr_6_q: When should I speak to a doctor?
faq_hr_6_a: Please speak to a healthcare professional if you notice rectal bleeding, pain that is getting worse, or severe or ongoing symptoms. A seat cushion is not a substitute for medical advice.
